jobs.title: Senior Electrical, Instrumentation and Control Engineer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a
  
  

Senior Electrical, Instrumentation and Control Engineer
  
  

to join our Engineering Team in Advario Singapore. The primary work location for this position is Jurong Island.
  
  

**Key Tasks:**  

1\) Automation \& Process control and Instrumentation System Design and Development
  
  

Lead the design, development and implementation of automation systems, including BPCS ( Basic Process and control system, PLC (Programmable Logic Controllers), SCS (Safety Control System ), F\&G SCS ( Fire and Gas Safety Control System ), and other industrial automation technologies
  
  

Evaluate Functional Design Specifications, supervise changes to Integrated Control and Safety System in accordance to Advario technical standards
  
  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand process requirements and develop automation solutions.
  
  

Develop and integrate process control strategies using instrumentation such as sensors, flow computer, batch controller, electric and pneumatic actuators
  
  

Integrate various control systems and instrumentation into the overall automation framework – e.g ICSS ( Integrated Control and Safety System )
  
  

Ensure automation systems and processes comply with industry standards, ADTS regulations and best practices (such as IEC, ISO)
  
  

Work to ensure safety features are incorporated into automation systems, especially in high\-risk environments
  
  

Continuously optimize process performance and automation systems for increased efficiency, reliability, and safety.
  
  

2\) Maintenance and Support
  
  

Provide ongoing support for automation systems, ensuring minimal downtime and swift resolution of any faults or malfunctions
  
  

Prepare and maintain documentation for automation systems, including standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides
  
  

Analyze system performance data and make recommendations for improvements or upgrades
  
  

3\) Project Management
  
  

Prepare budgets for automation projects, CAPEX and OPEX including tender packages
  
  

Manage schedules, and resources for automation\-related projects
  
  

Lead Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) and/or Hazard \& Operability Studies (HAZOP) for automation projects
  
  

4\) Training and Documentation
  
  

Provide training to plant operators, engineers, and other team members on automation systems and equipment
  
  

Create and update technical documentation, including system diagrams, process flowcharts
  
  

Prepare and maintain documentation for automation systems, including standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides
  
  

5\) Continuous Improvement
  
  

Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in process automation and instrumentation.
  
  

Suggest and implement new automation tools or techniques to improve process efficiency and reduce costs.
  
  

**Your Profile:**  

Possess at least a Degree in Electrical Engineering
  
  

Has at least 5 years of working experience as an EIC Engineer in the Oil \& Gas / Petrochemical Industry
  
  

Strong knowledge of ICSS, PLC, BPCS, F\&G SCS and SCS system
  
  

Strong knowledge in industrial communication protocols
  
  

Experience with process control algorithms and instrumentation calibration
  
  

Familiarity with automation tools and software (e.g., Siemens, ABB, Honeywell, etc.)
  
  

Proficiency in troubleshooting and problem\-solving automation and electrical systems
  
  

Familiarity with electrical infrastructure and design in industrial environments
  
  

Experience applying ISA\-88 (batch control), ISA\-95 (enterprise integration), OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP
  
  

Knowledge of predictive, preventive, and condition\-based maintenance strategies
  
  

Strong knowledge of ATEX and NFPA requirements in Oil and Gas industry
  
  

Familiarity with project management including contractor and budget management
  
  

Benefits
  
  

Special benefits and company events organized for employees
  
  

Comprehensive group insurance plan, including dependent coverage for hospitalization
  
  

Lunch provided while in the terminal and company shuttle bus transport to and from Jurong East MRT
  
  

Opportunity to work in a multinational company with a strong global presence in the storage and terminal industry
  
  

We are a leading global player in the storage industry, with a focused growth strategy on chemicals, gas and new energy and a strong commitment to embed ESG and sustainability across our entire operations. Advario is a carve\-out of Oiltanking GmbH and we are committed to play a frontrunner role in the energy transition through developing transformational partnerships.
  
  

The storage industry has a key role to play to progress the energy transition and ensure undisrupted, secure access to low carbon energy everywhere in the world. This transition is complex and requires close coordination and cooperation of all partners across the whole value chain. And that is exactly what our strategy is built on. We want to create better business through transformational partnerships. As fossil remains part of energy mix for some time to come, we will continue our services in this sector, but our growth focus therefore our investments dedicated to expanding our business across three segments: chemicals, gas, and increasingly new energies.
  
  

Through putting ESG at the heart of what we do, we achieve better business for our partners, society and ourselves. Besides ambitiously growing our business, we consider it equally important to operate our business highest care and safety standards for our people, the communities we work in and environments we live in. We want to make an impact in two ways. Firstly, by helping our customers reduce their CO2 footprint by enabling their transition to sustainable liquids and secondly by reducing our own emissions. So, we strive for a material share of sustainable revenues and we commit to net\-zero operations by 2040 latest.

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. You'll work in a small, full-stack team of 2-3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production.
Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and develop features that deliver real-world value.
Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.
Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, but you commit to travelling to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

Job Description

Do you enjoy building end-to-end digital solutions and shaping them together with customers? At Tieto Tech Consulting, you will work across the full technology stack, influence technical decisions, and help transform business ideas into scalable, cloud-ready solutions. We are looking for a (Senior) Fullstack Developer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting is the leading digital accelerator for innovation and sustainable value creation. We combine business design with software engineering to bring digital business to life.

As a (Senior) Fullstack Developer, you will take ownership of technical solutions from concept to production, actively contributing to architecture, technology choices, and implementation quality. You will work closely with customers and interdisciplinary teams, contribute to technical decision-making, and ensure high-quality delivery across both frontend and backend.

Work directly with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Develop scalable backend services and modern frontend applications
Ensure high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability
Participate in customer workshops, agile ceremonies, and solution discussions
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends
Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud-native web solutions on hyperscaler platforms (e.g. Azure), including architecture decisions and best practices
Continuously evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and practices

Who We Are Looking For

4+ years of experience as Fullstack Developer
Strong proficiency both in frontend (React and/or Angular) and backend technologies (Java and/or C#)
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices as well as with databases and cloud services
Experience in the use of AI-assisted development tools and methodologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, coding agents / agentic coding) to enhance development productivity and code quality, as well as to support documentation, testing, and problem-solving activities
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployment workflows
Strong communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset
A curious mindset and willingness to learn and share knowledge
Very good German and English skills

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end-to-end development process, you will continue to both learn from, and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We offer

We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance!
We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector.
We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful.
We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

Did we get you inspired? 

We look forward to your online application!

Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we will reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com

Hope to hear from you soon!

Location: Vienna, Linz, Graz, Berlin, Regensburg

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
